message.content:
You're rebuilding the Boldteq marketing website homepage at `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Boldteq/`. The current implementation is too generic and doesn't match the live site quality at boldteq.com. You need to make it look PREMIUM and POLISHED — like a top agency would charge for.

## Stack
- Next.js 16.2.3 (App Router, src/ directory)
- Tailwind CSS 4 (use `@theme inline` in globals.css, NO tailwind.config.js)
- shadcn/ui (base-nova style, components in src/components/ui/)
- framer-motion for animations
- embla-carousel-react + embla-carousel-autoplay for carousels
- TypeScript strict, no `any`
- pnpm

## Brand Colors (already in globals.css)
- Navy: `#092245` → `bg-brand-navy` / `text-brand-navy`
- Navy Deep: `#082753` → `bg-brand-navy-deep`
- Cyan: `#21cfff` → `text-brand-cyan` / `bg-brand-cyan`
- Blue: `#019ae6` → `text-brand-blue` / `bg-brand-blue`
- Yellow: `#FFEB85` → `text-brand-yellow` / `bg-brand-yellow`
- Gradient: `gradient-cyan` class (135deg, cyan to blue)
- Text gradient: `gradient-cyan-text` class

## Design Language from Live Site
- Clean white backgrounds with navy text sections
- Cards have subtle shadows: `shadow-[0_4px_24px_rgba(171,171,171,0.1)]`
- Cards hover: light cyan bg `#cdebfa` with cyan border `#009ce0`
- Buttons: primary = cyan gradient (90deg, #21cfff → #019ae6), rounded-full, px-6 py-3
- Section headings: text-[35px] leading-[45px] font-bold text-brand-navy, centered
- Body text: text-base text-gray-600, centered under headings
- Sections have generous padding: py-20 to py-28
- Border radius: rounded-xl (12-16px) for cards
- The site has a LIGHT theme overall — white/light backgrounds dominate, with occasional navy sections

## EXACT Homepage Sections (top to bottom):

### 1. HERO SECTION (white/light background)
- Small heading: "Your Dedicated Team — [TYPEWRITER]" where typewriter cycles: "Ownership Driven", "Without Hiring", "On Demand"
- Large heading below: "One Subscription. Predictable Execution."
- Body: "Boldteq becomes the team behind your agency — delivering QA-backed work with live request tracking, so you scale without chaos."
- Three trust badges in a row with icons: "14 Days Satisfaction Guarantee" | "No Contract" | "Pause or Cancel Anytime"
- Two CTA buttons: "Schedule Demo" (cyan gradient, rounded-full) | "14-Day Starter Trial" (outline/secondary)
- Below buttons: embedded GuideJar video iframe (https://www.guidejar.com/embed/xvH9rRaAyggwH1eetyrl?type=1&controls=on)

### 2. FEATURED IN LOGOS
- "Featured in:" label
- Logo images row: Forbes, Entrepreneur, Inc., The Washington Post, Philadelphia, Technically
- Grayscale logos, horizontal strip

### 3. PORTFOLIO CAROUSEL
- Slider showing work samples with category labels: Shopify, WordPress, Figma UI/UX Design, Banners
- Each slide has an image with a colored category badge below
- Left/right arrow navigation + dot indicators
- Dots: 12px circles, #EDF0F2 default, black active

### 4. PAIN POINTS SECTION (white bg)
- Heading: "What's Slowing Your Agency Down?"
- Subtext: "Running an agency shouldn't feel like constant firefighting. Yet most growing agencies hit the same roadblocks that quietly slow delivery, limit capacity, and hurt margins."
- Three cards side by side:
  1. "Bottlenecked Delivery" — "Your team is stretched thin. Projects move slower, timelines slip, and you're forced to turn down work you should be able to take on."
  2. "Unreliable Outsourcing" — "Freelancers and vendors deliver inconsistent quality, miss deadlines, or require constant follow-ups — putting your brand reputation and client trust at risk."
  3. "High Hiring Costs" — "Scaling through full-time hires means salaries, onboarding, tools, and long ramp-up times — all before you see real ROI."
- Each card has an illustration image, bold title, description text
- Cards have shadow, hover effect (bg-[#cdebfa], border-[#009ce0])

### 5. RESOLUTION BANNER (navy background)
- "Boldteq removes these blockers by acting as your dedicated white-label backend team giving you instant capacity, consistent quality, and predictable delivery."
- This is white text on dark navy, centered, large font (35px), with a small team avatar image inline
- "Schedule Demo" button below

### 6. WHO IS BOLDTEQ BUILT FOR (white bg)
- Heading: "Who Is Boldteq Built For?"
- Subtext: "Boldteq is designed to support agencies at different stages of growth — whether you're just starting out or scaling fast without wanting to rebuild your team."
- Four numbered items in a vertical list or grid:
  1. "#1. Starting Out" — "Winning clients is easy. You need reliable execution without full-time hires."
  2. "#2. Feeling Stretched" — "Your team is overloaded. Quality drops, deadlines slip, and opportunities are lost."
  3. "#3. Consistency" — "Repeatable systems keep quality stable, even as requests increase."
  4. "#4. Scaling Up" — "You need scalable capacity that adjusts to your workload."

### 7. BENEFITS SECTION (white bg)
- Badge: "Our Benefits"
- Heading: "Why Agencies Choose Boldteq Over Hiring"
- Subtext: "Agencies partner with Boldteq to get a senior, white-label execution team designed to support and deliver agency work."
- 6 benefit cards in 3x2 grid:
  1. "One place for everything" — "Requests, feedback, files, and approvals stay in a single workflow — no scattered tools."
  2. "Single point of responsibility" — "No bouncing between people or teams."
  3. "You control the queue" — "Your priorities decide what ships next."
  4. "Delivered with quality control" — "Internal QA catches issues before they reach you."
  5. "Flexible capacity, stable delivery" — "Workload changes without execution friction."
  6. "Structured execution flow" — "Each task moves through a defined system."
- Each card has an illustration/icon image, shadow, hover effect

### 8. HOW IT WORKS (navy/dark bg)
- Heading: "How Boldteq Works" (white text)
- Subtext: "A structured execution system built for agencies — simple requests, predictable delivery, and full white-label support."
- Three steps with images:
  1. "Choose Your Subscription" — "Start scaling today. Your delivery team is live within 12 hours."
  2. "Submit Your Tasks" — "Submit requests anytime. We start within hours, not days."
  3. "Review & Approve" — "We deliver white-label work you can confidently send to your clients."

### 9. PRICING PREVIEW
- Heading: "Pricing"
- Subheading: "Pick a Flexible Subscription. Get Predictable Output."
- Billing toggle: Monthly | Quarterly (Save 10%) | Annually (Save 20%)
- Three pricing cards:
  - Starter: $999/mo, "Agencies replacing first execution hire", 40hrs, 1 task, single platform, Smart Client Workspace
  - Growth (Most Popular): $1,999/mo, "Agencies scaling delivery", 80hrs, dual-lane, multi-platform, Smart Client Workspace
  - Pro: $3,499/mo, "High-volume / mature agencies", 140hrs, three-lane, advanced reporting, Smart Client Workspace
- "Choose Plan" button on each
- Feature comparison table below
- Custom plan section: "Need Something More Flexible?" with "Build Your Custom Plan" button

### 10. TRADITIONAL VS BOLDTEQ
- Two column comparison
- Left: "Traditional Way" with red X items showing problems
- Right: "Boldteq Way" with green checkmarks showing benefits
- Chat-style testimonial bubbles in each column

### 11. FAQ SECTION
- "Have question in mind?"
- "Frequently Asked Questions"
- Links to help center
- 8 expandable FAQ items using shadcn Accordion

### 12. NEWSLETTER SIGNUP
- "Join 500+ Subscribers"
- "Agency Growth Insights Delivered Monthly"
- Email input + subscribe button

### 13. BETA CTA (dark bg)
- "Exclusive Access — Private Beta Pricing"
- Benefits list
- "Only 15 agencies will be accepted in this beta round"
- "Join the Beta" CTA button

## Files to create/modify:

1. **`src/app/globals.css`** — Add any missing utilities needed
2. **`src/app/page.tsx`** — Complete homepage with all 13 sections
3. **`src/components/home/hero.tsx`** — Hero with typewriter
4. **`src/components/home/typewriter.tsx`** — Client component cycling text
5. **`src/components/home/featured-logos.tsx`** — Featured in logo strip
6. **`src/components/home/portfolio-carousel.tsx`** — Work carousel with embla
7. **`src/components/home/pain-points.tsx`** — Three pain point cards
8. **`src/components/home/resolution-banner.tsx`** — Navy banner with CTA
9. **`src/components/home/built-for.tsx`** — Who is Boldteq built for
10. **`src/components/home/benefits-grid.tsx`** — 6 benefit cards
11. **`src/components/home/how-it-works.tsx`** — 3-step process on dark bg
12. **`src/components/home/pricing-section.tsx`** — Full pricing with toggle + table + custom plan
13. **`src/components/home/comparison.tsx`** — Traditional vs Boldteq
14. **`src/components/home/faq-section.tsx`** — FAQ accordion
15. **`src/lib/constants/faq.ts`** — FAQ data
16. **`src/lib/constants/pricing.ts`** — Pricing data

## CRITICAL Quality Requirements:
- Every section must have scroll-in animations using framer-motion (fade up on scroll into view)
- Cards must have proper hover states with transitions
- Typography must be precise — large headings (35px+), proper line heights
- Use placeholder images where we don't have real assets yet (use colored rectangles with text overlay or emoji icons)
- Buttons MUST use the cyan gradient: `bg-gradient-to-r from-[#21cfff] to-[#019ae6]` with `rounded-full` and proper padding
- The overall feel must be PREMIUM — generous whitespace, refined typography, polished interactions
- Mobile responsive throughout
- Use `"use client"` only on components that need interactivity
- No `any` types anywhere

Read CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md first. Then read the existing globals.css and layout.tsx to understand the current setup. Then build everything.
